A hypothetical unlicensed lexeme (dog-lexeme, dog-root, NOT the woman-lemma) must never be analogized onto the closed suppletive-plural template just because the shape matches; the closed licensed_lexemes (lexeme_id, root) pair list is the only gate.

HOSTILE: the correct licensed root supplied under the WRONG lexeme_id (dog-lexeme, not the woman-lemma) must still abstain -- the root alone never manufactures the licence either.

An attested-looking pair with NO supplied root evidence must still abstain; the entry link alone is not root evidence.
A sound root with a real template id but NO exact entry-documented plural-form pairing must abstain -- shape resemblance to the broken-plural skeleton is never enough on its own.
A missing plural_template_id must abstain, never silently default to taksir-afal or any other pattern (the historical fusha_paradigm_generate.py bug this batch closes).

The-sun surface carries no ta marbuta, yet it is classically feminine. Absent an explicit registry fact, the projector must still abstain -- shape (even the ABSENCE of ta marbuta) never certifies gender.
With an explicit registry fact supplied, the-sun's feminine gender becomes a certifiable candidate.

The-tree surface carries ta marbuta, the strongest feminine cue -- but the projector must abstain just the same without an explicit registry fact, proving the gate is symmetric and never shape-decided either way.
With an explicit registry fact supplied, the-tree's feminine gender becomes a certifiable candidate -- the SAME gate that gated the-sun, regardless of the ta marbuta marker.

NEGATIVE FIXTURE: the entry's OWN attested_plurals list is a bare (unvocalized) skeleton, not a documented vocalized form -- norm_strict recall finds the skeleton match, but a bare attested-form entry is not itself a defeater-flagged near-miss (there is no SECOND vocalized candidate to collide or be harakah-blind against), so it falls through to the generic no_attested_lexeme_pair abstention rather than a false candidate.

An unrecognised template_id must return a typed unknown_plural_template_id abstention, never raise out of the projector/gate path -- a stale or malformed id is caller error, not grounds for an exception to escape into production.
